name: Personal leave, unpaid (事假)
authority: Interim Wage Payment Regulation (劳部发〔1994〕489号) arts.11–12 list the paid absences; personal leave outside them is unpaid, deducted at the monthly wage ÷ 21.75 a day (人社部发〔2025〕2号).

name: Annual leave (带薪年休假)
authority: 职工带薪年休假条例 (State Council Order 514, from 1 January 2008, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=208) art.2: a worker in continuous work for more than twelve months is entitled; art.3: cumulative service 1–10 years 5 days, 10–20 years 10, 20 or more 15 (statutory holidays and rest days inside it not counted); art.5: unused days paid at 300% of the day wage. 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法 (MOHRSS Order 1, from 18 September 2008, https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/trlzyhshbzbgz_17256/20200617/t0035_1388390.html) art.3: the twelve months may be with this or earlier employers; art.4: service with every employer counts toward the ladder (`employment.prior_service_months`); art.5: a new hire’s year is the calendar days left with this employer ÷ 365 × the full days, the part day dropped; art.12: a leaver’s year is (calendar days with this employer this year ÷ 365) × the full days less days taken, the part day dropped, no clawback of excess. Not modelled: the art.4 disqualifications (long paid personal or sick leave), a leap year read as 366 by CALENDAR_DAYS rather than the measure’s 365, and deemed service (register CN-N05, CN-N18). Recorded defaults where the law is silent (owner rule 2026-09-28; 人社厅函〔2009〕149号, http://www.mohrss.gov.cn/ldgxs/LDGXlaodongbiaozhun/LDGXLgongshixiujia/200904/t20090415_86611.html, answers only the twelve months and cumulative service): the calendar year in which twelve months are first completed is granted in full from the day they are, not pro-rated from that day (a 1 October 2025 hire with no earlier service holds 5 days for 2026 from 1 October 2026, and a 31 December 2026 exit is paid 5); a year in which cumulative service reaches 10 or 20 years is granted the higher band in full from that day (a 1 July 2016 hire holds 5 days for 2026 before 1 July 2026 and 10 from it). Neither grants less than a pro-rated reading.

name: Maternity leave (产假及生育假)
authority: 女职工劳动保护特别规定 (State Council Order 619, from 28 April 2012, https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/mobile/law/detail?LawID=343) art.7: 98 days of maternity leave, up to 15 before the birth; 15 more for a difficult birth and 15 more for each additional infant; a miscarriage under four months of pregnancy 15 days, at four months or more 42 days. 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment 17 January 2022, https://www.ynrd.gov.cn/html/2022/changweihuigonggao_0118/16355.html) art.18, with art.35 (every leave in the regulation is calendar days; working days inside it are paid): a lawful birth extends the maternity leave by 60 days of 生育假. Each infant beyond the second adds another 15 days, counted as the recorded children born on the event date (`children.multiple_born_on(event.date)`); a multiple birth with fewer than two recorded is refused. The Kunming maternity allowance (register CN-KM32) is outside this row.

name: Paternity leave (护理假)
authority: 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment 17 January 2022, https://www.ynrd.gov.cn/html/2022/changweihuigonggao_0118/16355.html) art.18, with art.35 (every leave in the regulation is calendar days; working days inside it are paid): the father of a lawful birth has 30 days of 护理假.

name: Marriage leave (婚假)
authority: 国劳总薪字〔1980〕29号: one to three paid days of marriage leave at the unit’s discretion (register CN-N51); 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment 17 January 2022, https://www.ynrd.gov.cn/html/2022/changweihuigonggao_0118/16355.html) art.18, with art.35 (every leave in the regulation is calendar days; working days inside it are paid): staff of every unit type who register a marriage have 15 more days. The seed grants the national three (the discretionary maximum) plus fifteen: 18 calendar days.

name: Childcare leave (育儿假)
authority: 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment 17 January 2022; Yunnan NPC Standing Committee consolidated text https://www.ynrd.gov.cn/html/2022/changweihuigonggao_0118/16355.html): a parent of a lawfully born or adopted child under three has 10 days of 育儿假 a year from their unit, 15 where two or more children are under three; art.35 counts the leave as attendance at normal pay. The year is the calendar year and the days do not carry over; they end when the child turns three (楚雄市卫生健康局 guidance, 18 Sep 2023, https://www.cxs.gov.cn/info/9025/254978.htm). Each parent holds the days separately; whether the other parent’s leave is taken is not a condition. The lawful-birth test is the operator’s record (register CN-KM12).

name: Family-planning procedure leave (计划生育手术假)
authority: 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (third amendment promulgated 17 January 2022), arts.19 and 35: leave is in calendar days and working days inside it are paid. IUD insertion/removal 7 days; tubal ligation/reversal 30; vasectomy/reversal 15; remedial procedure after contraception failure 15 days before 4 months of pregnancy or 42 at 4 months or more. IUD insertion or tubal ligation during maternity leave extends it. Calendar charging, maternity overlap and procedure evidence remain open (register CN-KM31). https://www.ynrd.gov.cn/html/2022/changweihuigonggao_0118/16355.html

name: Funeral leave (丧假)
authority: 国劳总薪字〔1980〕29号 item 1: one to three days of funeral leave at the unit’s discretion when a parent, the spouse or a child dies (register CN-N51; issuer text not retrieved, read in republication); 工资支付暂行规定 art.11 (https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/xxgk2020/gzk/gz/202112/t20211228_431557.html, read on MOHRSS 29 Sep 2026): during 丧假 the employer pays the wage at the contract standard. Owner rule 2026-09-28, law giving a range: the seed grants the discretionary maximum, 3, as MARRIAGE_LEAVE does; a unit that grants fewer lowers this row. Travel days (item 2) depend on distance and are not seeded. Added 29 Sep 2026 in every version.

name: Work-injury paid medical leave (停工留薪期)
authority: 工伤保险条例 art.33 (https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=610, read 29 Sep 2026): during the stop-work paid period 原工资福利待遇不变，由所在单位按月支付; the period is normally at most 12 months and may be extended, on the city labour-capacity appraisal committee’s confirmation, by at most 12 more. The period itself is the medical and committee determination (evidence required); the row caps it at 731 calendar days, the longest 24 months. Owner rule 2026-09-28, law silent on the wage measure: the contract wage continues for the charged days. The disability benefits after grading are CN-KM15. Added 29 Sep 2026 in every version (register CN-N21, CN-KM-WP13).
